title: Juicy Smoky Mediterranean Lamb Skewers
description: A paleo-friendly Mediterranean dish featuring lamb skewers with hoisin sauce and a floral twist, perfect for meal prep and grilling on a robata grill
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together hoisin sauce, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and oregano
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through
Meanwhile, grill the long fermentation dough pieces for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy
Serve the lamb skewers with grilled dough, crumbled feta cheese, and a side of mixed greens
